tasks.goal: Render a dedicated release-window row and a stable responsive five-metric row.
input_facts: Current template renders six direct summary children
Current desktop CSS defines only five tracks
selectedWindow and summary expose all required values
Frontend and backend services are running
invariants: No state, metric, permission, API or backend changes
No nested cards or new dependencies
interface_contracts: summary shape and metric semantics remain unchanged
CSS selectors remain local to release-ledger-summary
action_bounds: Adjust only baseline summary markup/classes and corresponding local CSS
Use five desktop columns, two narrow columns and one phone column
acceptance_checks: Dedicated window row contains code, name and status
Five metrics align in one equal desktop row
Responsive two-/one-column layout has no overlap or overflow
No-window behavior and business logic remain unchanged
Frontend build and diff checks pass
evidence_required: Desktop and responsive runtime evidence or explicit authentication limitation
tasks.rollback: Restore only the baseline summary markup block and corresponding local CSS rules.
stop_conditions: A third product file becomes necessary
A required window field is absent
An unrelated build failure cannot be isolated
escalation_conditions: User requests metric or interaction changes
The pattern must be generalized to other pages

checks: Inspect desktop and responsive layout when authenticated
